units.source_text: “阿芳，我要是那位小姐，会说得更加悦耳动听呢。

en.t: Ah Fang, if I were that young lady, I would say it in a much sweeter and more pleasing way.

units.source_text: 入秋以后，避暑地冷冷清清，如同找不到对象的老处女。”

en.t: After autumn sets in, the summer resort becomes cold and deserted, like an old maid who cannot find a partner.
